decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a transient multi-axis drop centered near index 500 with asymmetric recovery across axes, and (2) a prolonged E-axis offset from ~615–655 with incomplete return. No other windows show clear superposed or ambiguous morphologies beyond ordinary noise.

regions.observation: N/E/U show correlated multi-sample drop (~3–4 MAD) around index 495–505, with E and U exhibiting a shallow platform-like recovery while N rebounds more sharply; possible opposing return not fully resolved in this window.

E-component shows a sustained ~2-MAD downward shift from ~615 to ~655, accompanied by a weaker but coherent U dip and N fluctuation; the E offset appears persistent with ambiguous partial return near 660–665.
